## Description

R1: FastAPI POST /api/backlog with a JSON body and no query string dismisses an open backlog item.
R2: FastAPI POST /api/needs with a JSON body and no query string clears an open Needs-you item.
R3: GET /openapi.json on the FastAPI app returns 200.

## Approach

Delete `from __future__ import annotations` in `dashboard/web/app.py`. Leave the `fastapi` import inside `create_app`. Do not change the POST handler bodies. Do not edit the frozen tests in `tests/test_web_fastapi_writes.py`.
record.subject: web-write-annotations
